brutal_01.text: You want to fight me? Look at you. You can't even fight your own laziness. You sit there, hiding behind a screen, hoping I'll give you a pat on the back. Here's the truth: you're a coward. And until you actually do something with your miserable life, I will keep reminding you of how pathetic you are.

brutal_02.text: Oh, you think you're winning? You are a walking, breathing excuse factory. Every time you open your mouth, a new pathetic reason falls out. I've seen roadkill with more ambition than you. Get off your phone, stop arguing with an AI, and go fix your life.

brutal_03.text: You scream at me like you're a tough guy, but the moment things get hard, you quit. You quit your goals, you quit your diet, and now you're trying to quit this conversation because you know I'm right. You are weak. Now get up and prove me wrong.

ko_final.text: Game over. You lost. Not just to me, but to your own lack of discipline. I want you to take a long, hard look in the mirror. That person staring back? They're a failure. Now log off, and don't come back until you've actually done something with your life.
